name: rostech
description: Small mods for Claude Code, for working at a glance.

plugins.name: gas-gauge
plugins.description: A fuel gauge above the prompt: how much of your Claude plan is left, and when it refills.

plugins.name: context-limit
plugins.description: A temperature dial above the prompt: how full the context window is, from C to H.

plugins.name: sticky-note
plugins.description: A note that sits above the prompt until you clear it.

plugins.name: needs-you-chime
plugins.description: Plays a sound when Claude finishes or needs an answer from you.

plugins.name: hands-off
plugins.description: Files you mark as yours. Claude cannot edit them until you say so.

plugins.name: on-camera
plugins.description: Streaming mode. Hides names, paths and keys you list from tool output before they reach the screen.

plugins.name: tool-gaps
plugins.description: Finds the commands you keep typing by hand that should be tools.

plugins.name: house-style
plugins.description: Your reply rules, sent to Claude every turn, with one switch to turn them off.

plugins.name: page-pile
plugins.description: Keeps a dated local copy of every artifact page Claude publishes. Only ever adds.

plugins.name: odometer
plugins.description: How long this session has run and what it has cost, on the dash.

plugins.name: control-panel
plugins.description: A pane of every setting you use, with the word that changes each one.

plugins.name: drop-folder
plugins.description: A band when files are waiting in a folder you name, like a phone drop.

plugins.name: read-aloud
plugins.description: Reads the last answer out loud.

plugins.name: open-it
plugins.description: Opens a result in your browser, with markdown rendered first.

plugins.name: clip
plugins.description: Puts a value on your clipboard, cleaned of terminal decoration.

plugins.name: record
plugins.description: Writes every exchange to a dated file you keep.

plugins.name: clock
plugins.description: The real time on the dash, read at the moment you look.

plugins.name: pin
plugins.description: A pinned to-do band above the prompt.

plugins.name: turn-meter
plugins.description: How long and how many tool calls each turn took, charted.

plugins.name: perm-audit
plugins.description: A pane of what this machine lets Claude do, read from settings.

plugins.name: leak-guard
plugins.description: Refuses a git commit that carries a value you listed as private.

plugins.name: human-signoff
plugins.description: Refuses a release step until a person marks it played.

plugins.name: memory-trim
plugins.description: Keeps your memory index under the length Claude reads in full.

plugins.name: run-by-name
plugins.description: Runs a repo script by its bare name.

plugins.name: skins
plugins.description: Claude Code wearing a colour skin of your choice.
